patch.objective: Why real-time streaming analytics matters for a modern business

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Cloud Digital Leader exam guide (PDF, 'launched on August 12, 2026'): six sections, 18% each for the first five and 10% for Scaling with Google Cloud Operations
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-18; the section names and weights match the course seed. Bullet wording quoted from the HTML guide page (cloud.google.com/learn/certification/guides/cloud-digital-leader, read 2026-11-17): 1.2.e 'Discuss how Google Cloud supports digital transformation with global infrastructure and data centers connected by a fast, reliable network'; 2.1.b 'Differentiate between basic data management concepts, in particular: databases; data warehouses; data lakes'; 2.3.c 'Describe how streaming analytics in real time makes data more useful and generates business value'; 3.1.e 'Explain why high-quality, accurate data is essential for successful ML models'; 4.1.b 'Define the main cloud migration terms'. That HTML page showed weights of about 16-17% per section, which the PDF supersedes.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Stop a running Dataflow pipeline
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: canceling 'stops the Dataflow service from processing any data, including buffered data' and 'You might lose in-flight data when you cancel a job'; draining (streaming only) 'enables the Dataflow service to finish processing the buffered data while simultaneously ceasing the ingestion of new data'; on drain, Dataflow 'immediately closes any in-process windows and fires all triggers'.

sources.cite: waitingforcode.com, Late data in Apache Beam
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17 (a third-party explanation, to verify against the Apache Beam programming guide). Relevant text: 'By default late events are rejected from the window'; data arriving after the end of the window and of the allowed lateness is 'droppable late data'; withAllowedLateness 'defines how long late data will be accepted'; its example accepts a late element with accumulating fired panes and fires a later pane. The droppedDueToLateness counter name in the scenario is from memory of Beam (to verify).
